description:
Result of validating a single crop region against safety rules.

Used to report whether a proposed crop operation is safe to execute
automatically or requires manual review.

pdf_page_index.description: Zero-based page index of the source PDF page
pdf_page_index.title: Pdf Page Index

actual_width_px.description: Actual rendered width in pixels (if computed)
actual_width_px.title: Actual Width Px

actual_height_px.description: Actual rendered height in pixels (if computed)
actual_height_px.title: Actual Height Px

expected_width_px.description: Expected width in pixels from profile target
expected_width_px.title: Expected Width Px

expected_height_px.description: Expected height in pixels from profile target
expected_height_px.title: Expected Height Px

dimension_match.description: Whether actual dimensions match expected (None if not yet computed)
dimension_match.title: Dimension Match

tick_deviation_x_mm.description: Tick mark deviation on X axis in mm (4-Up only)
tick_deviation_x_mm.title: Tick Deviation X Mm

tick_deviation_y_mm.description: Tick mark deviation on Y axis in mm (4-Up only)
tick_deviation_y_mm.title: Tick Deviation Y Mm

tick_within_tolerance.description: Whether tick deviations are within tolerance (≤ 1.0 mm per Spec §6.B)
tick_within_tolerance.title: Tick Within Tolerance

title: CropValidationResult
